generator.only_explicit_input_change: construction reference-axis vertical Fourier coefficients multiplied by -1

screening.criterion_for_adam200: native ABI-11 status == ok on the exact optimizer-representable start
screening.representation_order: construct exact-unclipped float32 standardized start, reconstruct physical tokens, then screen those same tokens
screening.configuration: the same score_config(iota_degree=3, surface_theta_count=128) used by optimizer formal centers, with global axis search only for screening
screening.execution: one candidate at a time per worker; every valid candidate immediately enters Adam200
screening.axis_continuation: screening axis_R/axis_Z are retained and required as strict optimizer step-0 hints
screening.pre_update_consistency_gate: abs(strict-hint optimizer step-0 score - screening score) <= 0.1

parallelization: four P107 workers plus two Students workers; no cross-worker dependency
serial_reason_within_worker: screening determines whether that candidate has a valid Adam start and the same GPU runs its immediate optimizer

optimizer.direction_policy: fresh random orthogonal directions per update
